newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Most Australian budget work done - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Most Australian budget work done - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government had achieved most of the work needed to bring the budget back into balance.

"Further fiscal tightening will be required as we continue to work towards the aim of balancing the budget over the term of this parliament, but we've broken the back of the work," Costello told reporters.
"We've put in place A$7.0 billion worth of savings over the last two years and we've made very substantial progress."
Costello earlier announced a revised forecast for the 1996/97 underlying budget deficit of A$8.49 million, compared with the A$5.65 million forecast in the August budget.
The forecast was issued as part of the government's regular mid-year review of budget projections.
The budget year ends on June 30.
The underlying budget deficit excludes items such as asset sales and early repayment of debt by the states.
